prompt:
RGBA image with an alpha channel and a fully transparent background. A wide panoramic background layer for a side-scrolling 2D cartoon, seen from the side at eye level. The layer runs across the whole width of the image and touches the left, right and bottom edges. The upper part of the image above it is fully transparent, with no sky, no sun, no moon and no clouds. The layer is the waterfront of a small ramshackle Caribbean port town:
a row of crooked wooden houses and shops on stilts with slanted roofs, a
tavern with a hanging sign with no letters, a few lit warm yellow windows,
and the masts and furled sails of two old tall ships behind them, in ochre,
brick red, faded teal and plum. Flat vector illustration in the style of a 1990s hand-drawn cartoon adventure game for grown-ups: exaggerated, slightly angular proportions, long limbs, expressive faces, solid color fills in rich, slightly muted colors such as deep teal, ochre, brick red, plum and sea green, no gradients, no texture, no shading. Bold, even near-black outline around every shape.  No text, no letters, no people.
